'''Tomàs Molina i Bosch''' (born September 26, 1963) is a [[Catalans|Catalan]] [[meteorologist]] and [[TV presenter]]. He's been working as the [[Televisió de Catalunya]] [[weather broadcaster]] for over 30 years and has directed its meteorological department since 1987.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Banyeres |first=R. |date=2020-10-04 |title=Tomàs Molina: "En els propers deu anys, a Lleida passareu molts cops dels 40º de temperatura" |url=https://www.segre.com/ca/lectura/entrevista/201004/tomas-molina-els-propers-deu-anys-lleida-passareu-molts-cops-dels-de-temperatura_265666.html |access-date=2024-04-01 |website=[[Diari Segre]] |language=ca}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2024-03-31 |title=Tomàs Molina serà candidat d'ERC a les eleccions europees |url=https://www.vilaweb.cat/noticies/tomas-molina-candidat-erc-eleccions-europees/ |access-date=2024-04-01 |website=[[VilaWeb]] |language=ca}}</ref> He's been described as "[[Catalonia]]'s most beloved weather man".<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Portet |first=Anouk |date=2024-03-29 |title=Tomàs Molina: "És mentida que és la fi del món i que tot és una merda" |url=https://www.diaridebarcelona.cat/w/entrevista-tomas-molina-es-mentida-que-es-fi-mon-que-tot-es-merda |access-date=2024-04-02 |website=[[Diari de Barcelona]]}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Molina studied [[physical sciences]] at the [[University of Barcelona]], specializing in [[geoscience]] and [[cosmology]] before receiving a doctorate in [[communication]]. Since 2000, he has been an [[associate professor]] at the university,<ref name=":1" /> teaching [[weather forecasting]] and [[meteorology]].<ref name=":0" />

Molina is also a vice presidents of the board of the {{Ill|International Association of Broadcast Meteorology|es|IABM}},<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Tomàs Molina |url=https://www.llull.cat/catala/literatura/books_catalan_autor.cfm/id/37579/tomas-molina |access-date=2024-04-01 |website=[[Institut Ramon Llull]]}}</ref> as well as one of the board directors of the [[Meteorological Service of Catalonia]] and a [[European Climate Pact]] Ambassador.<ref name=":1" /> He has published several meteorology-themed books, including ''Contes del temps: Una història per a cada mes de l’any'' ({{Literal translation|Stories about the Weather: One for Every Month of the Year}}), ''Meteocuriositats: 50 secrets per entendre el temps'' ({{Literal translation|Meteofacts: 50 Untold Secrets About the Weather}}), and ''El gran llibre del planeta'' ({{Literal translation|The Definitive Guide to the Planet}}).<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" />

Molina works as a TV presenter for [[Televisió de Catalunya]], primarily hosting the [[TV3 (Catalan TV channel)|TV3]] program ''El Temps'' ({{Literal translation|The Weather}}).<ref name=":0" /> He has been the director of the channel's meteorological department since 1987.<ref name=":1" /> Even so, he has also worked as a [[radio presenter]].<ref name=":3" />

In 2024, he announced he would be a candidate for the [[2024 European Parliament election|European Parliament election]] representing the [[Republican Left of Catalonia]], which would contest the elections alongside [[EH Bildu]], the [[Galician Nationalist Bloc]], and [[Ara Més]] in a coalition named [[Ara Repúbliques]]. He was selected based on his prominence in the [[climate movement]] in Catalonia.<ref name=":1" /> Following the results, which granted Ara Repúbliques just three [[Member of the European Parliament|MEPs]], the coalition decided to split the position between him and [[Ana Miranda Paz]], who was third overall running for the Galician Nationalist Bloc. Molina is expected to work as a MEP between 2027 and 2029.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lleonart |first=Andreu |date=2024-06-11 |title=Tomàs Molina vol tornar a aparèixer a TV3 fins que no sigui eurodiputat |url=https://www.vilaweb.cat/noticies/tomas-molina-vol-tornar-a-apareixer-a-tv3-fins-que-no-sigui-eurodiputat/ |access-date=2024-06-11 |website=[[VilaWeb]] |language=ca}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Molina has been married to physician Maria Antònia Grífols since 1991. They have three children: Núria, Pol and Joan.<ref name="enotic">{{Cite web |last=Fernández |first=Judith |date=2024-03-19 |title=Tomàs Molina: la seva fe en Déu i la seva 'avorrida' història d'amor amb la seva dona |url=https://e-noticies.cat/televisio/tomas-molina-seva-fe-deu-seva-avorrida-historia-amor-seva-dona |access-date=2024-04-01 |website=e-noticies.cat |language=ca}}</ref>

Molina is Catholic.<ref name="enotic" />
